content: When you received Christ you received more than you think you did! In the past we were taught that Christ is only a ticket to Heaven, but the truth is you received the fullness of God, the fulfillment of every promise and blessing! You are a citizen of Heaven and a Child of the King! Yours is now to discover and experience all that is yours in Christ! This is through knowledge, the more knowledge you acquire the more access you have to your inheritance in Christ! Desire to know Him more, and watch your life excel from Glory to Glory!

Everyday is designed for your progress in the reality where time is; things have the ability to change, don't waste any moment, see the opportunities for growth and improvement all around you today, its what draws you closer to where you desire to be. The Lord has provided all that you need to fulfill your destiny look out for learning and growth moments all throughout the day and lean into them.

Prayer in and of itself is a very powerful tool for definite change. But there is something about a whole nation lifting up their voice in prayer as one unto the Lord! There is a release of the Heavenly mandate over a nation. If the people of God will pray He will move in His power and bring Healing and restoration to a land. Turning away from the negatives or politics let us look to God, pray for the Nation for in it's prosperity you shall prosper. There is so much wickedness that is held back and so much the is glory released over the Nation as we pray! Such a time is never wasted or in vain.

It's is never in vain to trust the Lord, He is faithful and His Word never fails, most have found themselves condemnation of with an affliction in their body, but the truth is the Forgiveness, Provision and Health that are in God are forever settled issues, you can be sure that they are available and fully paid for, anyone can receive by Faith, Jesus already purchased all our salvation and deliverance walk in the full light of it.

Give more earnest heed to what the Lord is doing inside you, it's not about the outward expression of success in life or ministry, what matters most is what is going on inside you, how is your Character and relationship with Christ! Glory in your personal vibrant fellowship with God and not the outward appearance of Christianity!

Every saint of God that served the Lord and was counted for any acclaim lived a life of Devotion. Now this is not a picture of complete separation from people and the world as we know it, but it is life where what matters most to you is your relationship and fellowship with God! Where your heart and mind are consumed by the thought of Heavens mandate for your life. Live devoted to God that's your most profitable life!

The destiny of any nation is in the hands of the Lord, He created every people group for a purpose. When we come to the celebrate the work of Christ it goes beyond just the redemption of mankind, His death serves for the saving of races, cultures and whole nation's! God is interested in affairs of nations and has assigned angels over them, may this nation walk out the fullness of God's desire and destiny, even as her people do.

We are the bride of Christ, we are beautiful, we are the most prized possession in all creation, the Fathers heart is for you, Jesus is in Love with you, His heart is all out for you. Don't let anyone down play who you are and how He sees you. You are not called to be a servant or a worker, you are called to an intimate relationship with Christ, to fellowship and oneness. You have been justified, you are the righteousness of God in Christ! Show forth His glory!

Jesus is beyond a mere example of kindness and compassion. He is the new way to be human! He is Infact beyond man, He became like man that we may become partakers of the divine nature, that we may be members of the God Class: the Godkind! This is God work in you, you are called to show forth the divinity of Christ to the world!

There is an expectation in you for greatness, your whole being dreams about reaching towards a higher and better experience of life! God has placed it in every man that they may reach towards the Son Jesus! We are called to walk in fullness of Christ, that's the only satisfaction of the Spirit, soul and body!

Convenience leads to mediocrity, the path of less resistance never leads to the mountain peak. God has placed so much in front of you, but it will call you out of your comfort zone to a place of Trust. If you believe that God has provided greatness in front of you in Christ Jesus go for it! Be moved by you Convictions not convenience.

What are your convictions about the Gospel of Jesus Christ? What does your heart know to be true about Him? who do you say that He is? Without convictions you will be swayed by every thing that comes. You must hold fast to what you believe about who Jesus is, this is done through meditation! Let the truth of God be a strong foundation in your life, then shall you walk in the power of the Gospel and enjoy all its benefits!

God calls us to be strong and rooted in the truth, we cannot allow ourselves to wavier when it comes to the Word of God! Jesus said he who hears my sayings and does them is like a man who built His House on the rock when the storm came and the winds blew that house stood. The truth works for those in whom it is settled!

The Word of God is the only source of establishment, the facts that science and technology offer are ever changing, but the Word of God is forever settled in the heavens. We can be sure of the divine and blessed assurance that we have in Christ, for when you have the Word you shall not be moved! Don't let the facts of life define your reality live in the reality of the Word.

Never lose sight of what the Lord spoke to you! The things you have heard about your life and destiny, hold fast to; and never be talked out of them. The Word never gets old, time has got no effect on the Word of God, do not forget what was spoken to you, it shall come to pass, God spoke to Abraham about having a son but Isaac only came 25 years later, for all those Years Abraham staggered not at the Promises of God but was strong in Faith. That Word over your life is coming to pass!

You have an empowerment from Heaven to be exceptional at all that you do! The Holy Ghost is not mediocre at what He does, When He comes upon someone's life, He marks himher for excellence all around! You have excellence as your default setting, it's who you are, lean into and walk out that glorious life!

God is not partial at anything that He does He is able to save to the utmost, He goes all the way into perfection! When we come to receive from God don't go about it with a "do whatever you can Lord" mindset, be sure that He only gives perfect gifts! He supplies according to His riches in Glory, not according to the size of your need!

There's a place of full conviction where the truth of God that is revealed to you, is the reality of your life. This is the working of the Holy Ghost, He leads us into all truth, that's more than merely revealing truth to you, He brings you into the reality and experience of the Truth! Give yourself into the revelation that you know, the God you know is the God you will show.

The quality of your life has a strong correlation to the quality of your decisions, what drives you? What's your outlook on life? As a believer our view of life is in the Word of God! We don't have to grope about in darkness over any issue in life, our reality is what the see by revelation in the Word of God! The Just shall live by Faith we live by our convictions of God's Word!

Jesus gave His life for us to live and experience the God kind of life, to live anything less than that is an afront to the Gospel of Jesus Christ! The Blood of Jesus is not a cheap thing, to say we are just to barely get by in life is an expression of true Christianity, is an inaccurate picture of the sacrifice of the Lamb of God!

What is Heaven to you? What does the thought of Heaven register as in your mind? What ecstasy floods you heart as you ponder that Glorious wonders of Heaven? When Jesus taught His disciples to pray He told them to ask the Father that His will be done on Earth as it is in Heaven! We are called to show forth the reality of Heaven right here right now! The fabric between Heaven and Earth is wearing line, as we reveal the Heart of the Father to the World! Let Heaven Come!

The highest order of things is the Authority of the Word of God! He has exalted His Word above all His name! The Lord desires us to have assurance of Life and glory in Christ! The Word is a sure foundation of all things that the Lord has made available! It is higher than all laws of nature, it is not limited to the principles of economics! It is the highest order of things, all Creation bows to its Authority!

There are certain things that exclusively belong to the brave and courageous! There is a kind of life that can only be made available to you when you step out of the bounds of what is comfortable and convenient! Jesus is calling you deeper, further away from the shore is where the true treasures of life are! As a believer by default you have faith and courage in your spirit! Walk it out and accomplish all that God has set before you, refuse to quit or fear! You are well able!

The destiny that God has made known to you is guaranteed to those who will not quit believing. Don't let go of your Faith rather feed it! Surround yourself with voices that speak life into your dreams. You can be all God created you to be! Jesus died to make it possible, your spirit is already wired to succeed and fulfil the plan and purposes of God! Keep the path, turn on the courage cut out fear.

The starting up of anything is usually the hardest part. But once you break through that barrier you are on set on a path of success. Every step is motion and it brings you closer to the desired destination. God is committed to fulfilling all that He has placed in you, but you have to take that first step!

No matter how far you feel you have strayed from God all it takes is one step to get back to Him. The truth is He never leaves us nor forsake us. The Fathers Love never stops pursuing us, He purchased our salvation at a price that no one and nothing could ever counter offer. The Blood of Jesus is the Greatest Sacrifice in all existence. It's cleansing Power is flawless, His Love is Relentless!

The whole of Heaven is backing you, the plan and purpose of God is to bring you to the fullness of the call of God on your life! The Lord has called you to fulfill great things in the Earth! Don't sale yourself short, all Heaven sees you in light of all that God has given you! The path is already set before you, run with passion and purpose, you have the Power of the Holy Ghost at your disposal He is your Helper!

The first person God calls you to be is yourself, God knew exactly what He was getting Himself into when He called you to fulfill the destiny He has for. The call of God goes beyond yourself to the Person of Christ in you! God sees you in the Light of perfection. The nature of Christ is your life! That is the real you!

The manifest presence of God does not come by chance, the notion that we have to pull and beg God to show up in our lives or services is not an accurate picture of who the Father desires to manifest Himself in our lives! Remember you are the temple of the Holy Spirit! You are the one to manifest the Presence of God!

Don't look behind you, there is a reason God placed our eyes to look at what's in front of us by default! What you need to press into is what is ahead of you! Thank God for the successes of the past, but don't live there move forward into all that God has for you! Greater Experiences are ahead!

There is something that you have inside of you that the Father placed there to bless and impact the world. Don't look outwardly to find who God made you to be, look on the inside, there lies the treasure that the world is eagerly awaiting. You were brought forth with purpose, made to fulfill great things in the Earth! Let your light shine you have so much to give, You are Loaded with Greatness!!!

It's a new day, embrace the newness that the Lord is releasing over your life! You are called to an experience in God that goes beyond what you have known or become familiar with. It will take you letting go of the old to lay hold of what is yours in Christ Jesus! Welcome to your new life!

This is the start of something new, the Lord is giving new strength, new ability, new passion for life! New life is springing forth! It doesn't matter what point you are at, the Lord is renewing your strength! It's time to dream again, to refocus on the mission! There is a burst of newness in your career, academics, ministry, relationships, marriage etc.

How is your love walk, the greatest measure of Spirituality is ones ability to walk in Love! How do you take it when people speak against you? Where is your breaking point on forgiveness? What are your limits? When we look at the Love of God and it's boundless dimensions that's the call of God for us, we are to live in the reality and Power of Love! Love is the Greatest!

Love is your nature, you have the life and nature of Jesus Christ in you, the Law of the New Testament is Love! We are a people of Love walking in the Fullness and newness of God! He Has written His Law in our hearts, not the 10 commandments but Law of Love! This is the power by which we do all our endeavors! You are a man or woman for Love.

We are here on Earth to show the Power and compassion of Christ to the whole world! Love is the mightiest force in the whole Universe! It affects every sphere of human interaction, and it is the ultimate expression of worship and faith in God! We are a people of Love! We express our Faith in God by the way we Love others! Love is the God nature within us! 1John.4.20 If a man say, I love God, and hateth his brother, he is a liar: for he that loveth not his brother whom he hath seen, how can he love God whom he hath not seen?

God Loves you more than you can wrap your mind around! His Love is so vast and unchanging He pursues you even in your worst state, the vilest sinners can't escape it! The first experience we have with God is a Love Encounter! Love needs no reason, Love Love's because He loves. No one can ask God to Love them, He sovereignly chose to Love us! We are called the Children of His Love, Love gave birth to us!

When the angels look at us they see us in the Light of what our lives are giving off! You may hide your motives and thoughts from men but all Heaven sees us in the Light of truth! The Desire of God is for us to Look like LOVE, to manifest the presence and glory of God!! Let Love motive all your thoughts and deeds! It is your God nature.

No one can't ever claim that God doesn't Love them! Many look at their circumstances and write off a loving God because they feel if God truly Loved them they would not be in that situation! Well the truth is Jesus is God's love for us, His blood is the Testament upon which we receive all things from God! God can never deny you anything! He loved us before we ever cried out for help! He cannot deny you now, rest in His Love! We don't pray for God to prove His Love, we pray and are thankful because God loves you!

We have seen the effects of sin and it's devastation. We look at the things happening in the world today are in awe of how the bondage of sin has ruined lives, institutions and Nations. But there is a force that is more Powerful than sin, that is Love. Love takes over and dominates when sin seemed to have permanent residence! Love destroys sin and it's effects completely and brings all things into the Perfection of God! The solution to sin is "For God so loved the world... " the coming of Christ undid the works of all sin and it's effects!

Love is possibility, Love is creativity, Love is Power! Love unlocks any and every door! There is No one who is beyond its reach! One maybe out of Faith and a situation maybe beyond hope, But Love Never Fails! It never stops, it is the Power that raised Jesus Christ from the died! This is the nature that the Father desires us to walk out and experience! Love is unbeatable, unstoppable and forever true! This is your life and strength, you are born of Love!

The Greatest motivation for anything is Love, in the whole spectrum of things the reason why Jesus came is because God so LOVED the world... You have the God nature in you, let Love be your motivation for all things! Love never fails it will keep on giving and yielding results over and over again! Become an stoppable walk in Love!

Let not your love be partial, you Have an ability that is the very nature of God In you that causes you to produce love in truth in every situation! Love is the fruit of your spirit, you can't but love! Let your love he in Truth, let the recipient see the compassion and unique concern for them! This is the God life in you!

Compliments of the season, around this time of year there is so much love being passed around, everyone seems happy and desires to be with loved ones! Well it's because this time of year everyone celebrates the greatest display of Love! God becoming man that we may know Him and be found in Him. This whole season is built on the fact that God became a man, oh what Joy to the world, oh what Love that He came into our situation and was found like us to the end that we may be found Like Him.

The choice is yours, your dreams are before you! You can achieve them, you can be as big as you desire to be! The ability and Power is available! All Heaven's supply is at your disposal, your time is now to fulfil the fullness of what God has called you to walk in. Rise up and take it now! Be strong and very courageous, Take what is yours fulfill, your dreams! Be the best that God has called you to be!

Jesus Christ came to bring light to the World, He is and was the Light of the World, He came to bring Light. In the beginning God commanded light to shine out of darkness! In these days He has spoken to us by His Son who is the Brightness of His very own image... Jesus however has ascended into Heaven, yet the Light of the world is still here; It's Christ in You, you are the light of the world now! You are the one to shine the light of the glory of God in the world around you!

You are well able, don't look to your own ability it's not by your own strength but by His Grace, the divine enablement of God! The task before us is of God, therefore He is not expecting you to go at it by power or by might! The Holy Ghost is your helper, there is more power at your disposal than you think, He will organize the people, He will make the funds available, yours is to make a relentless decision to launch out into all that He has spoken to you!

Compliments of the Season, oh this blessed festive time is once again upon us! It's a time marked by love, giving and the warmth of Family. This year in as much as you will receive from, and it give gifts to your friends and loved ones, be the Gift! May this Christmas be so memorable to those around you by your very presence! Let the Love of God be experienced by everyone who comes in contact with you. You are a blessing and as Jesus came as a gift to the world, so He is sending you to be the same to your world!

As the Year comes to a close, so much has happened truly the Lord is merciful. He mercies are new every morning, you can be sure that His Love is from everlasting to everlasting! Jesus is the Author and Perfector of our Faith, He is the fulfilment of every blessing that you desired to have in this year, do lose hope keep your eyes on the prize! He is your reward, the crowning joy of every Year! Let Christ and His fullness be your experience and testimony of this year! For in Him all the promises of God are yes and Amen!

There's a place for you among the greats of the world! You have read, heard and seen them, yet all that God was doing was pointing out to you that you can do it too. It is your turn now! Believe it, don't deny the world of you! You are the only you there will ever be. Be the best you and walk in the Light of God's glory! You have something great to give!
